speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)

Natalizumab is a potent immunosuppressant used for Crohn's and Multiple Sclerosis, but it carries a known risk of causing PML, a severe infection of the brain. Given your history of uncontrolled Crohn's disease and one year of natalizumab therapy, combined with new onset ataxia, we must urgently rule out this complication. I am requesting an MRI of the brain to look for characteristic white matter lesions.
